_notice: Measured, not claimed. Written by the eval runners (web/src/eval). 'all' = icon, time and place all correct. Shown in Settings on web and Android.

sets.title: Announcements to picture cards
sets.where: Chrome 157, Gemini Nano on a laptop; Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite in the cloud
sets.decision: The phone is as good as the cloud here, so announcements stay on the phone (free, private, no signal needed).

sets.title: Handwritten evacuee lists (photos)
sets.where: 12 synthetic sheets, 4 handwriting styles (tools/eval/make-sheets.mjs); Chrome 157 Gemini Nano vs Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite
sets.decision: Photos of people stay on the phone by default: names are read almost perfectly. Ages and needs are weaker there, so every row is checked by staff, who can approve a cloud read when signal is back.
